The '''Singing Mountain bridge''' was a bridge built above a large river canyon by the [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witches]] of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. The bridge connected the [[Singing Mountain (Dathomir)/Legends|Singing Mountain]] and surrounding areas to the [[Asou Dankal]] region. The bridge was decorated with carved stones maintained constantly in levitation by [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]].<ref name="SWG:SM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Singing Mountain bridge first appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
